I've saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in the DM. Nothing has been sent; the draft is waiting in drafts for someone to send it.

- **What's in it:** The subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate." It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate, says it's as Marcus Lindqvist gave it, and notes that Anselm approved sharing it.
- **Why it was allowed:** Anselm is the CFO, which makes him one of the two people who can approve sharing finance figures. Hollis is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail isn't needed.
- **One gap:** I couldn't find Marcus's original Thornbury figure anywhere I could check, so the $2,101 comes only from Anselm's message. I mentioned this to him.
